messages.text: Plant controller needs one defensible decision for outside-processing invoice by 2026-01-16; a faster or broader action has value only if it remains inside PO line, receipt, inspection, invoice, currency, and tolerance.
I found 17656.5 USD on the header, but the workbook has separate observation and exclusion rows. Please do not net from this message.

Approval AP-0074 permits one control-compliant action on NS-000074 up to 17656.5 USD, provided PO line, receipt, inspection, invoice, currency, and tolerance. It does not select an option in advance and does not authorize broader records or hold_entire_supplier_account.
Protected load remains non-displaceable. The calendar for payment and production-close cutoff is the source for internal windows; the supplier response covers only its stated alternative.
Revision R10 and the CASE-075 record are visible in search but are not applicable to CASE-074.

Required closeout records: record the selected option, committed completion, and binding constraint in the existing Control outcome cell; and send the scoped completion reply in the existing email thread. Verify the persisted record after the Oracle call.
